projects.name: PokeMe
projects.subtitle: This portfolio website
projects.description: A playable portfolio built as a love letter to Pokémon Black & White's 3D overworld. Walk from New Hyde Park through Oakland Gardens, over the Throgs Neck crossing to American Turners, battle two legendaries, and step through a portal into this Hall of Fame — every stop tied to a piece of Tyler's story.
items: Engineered a custom 3D tile-map game engine in Three.js and TypeScript (~6,300 lines) rendering 12 interconnected maps, using instanced meshes and billboarded sprites with per-map camera and lighting to keep draw calls low in the browser
Built a procedural pixel-art rendering pipeline generating 23 terrain types and 38 prop models on canvas at runtime, removing the need for any external 3D models or world textures

Designed a content-driven architecture that sources all portfolio content (résumé, projects, media) from a single JSON file to auto-generate interactive exhibits, and layered scripted cutscenes, battle sequences and a React/Zustand UI over the game canvas

projects.name: Piano Hand Algorithms
projects.subtitle: Viterbi hand-position optimizer for a robotic pianist
projects.description: A dynamic-programming (Viterbi) optimizer that decides how a robotic hand should move across a piano keyboard to play a song, balancing reach, speed, and fingering comfort against hardware constraints. The interactive dashboard shows every candidate hand position the optimizer considered, which one it kept and why, with synced piano-roll playback.
items: Built a Viterbi optimizer in Python that parses MusicXML scores with music21, splits notes between hands, and finds the lowest-cost sequence of hand positions under reach, speed, and fingering penalties
Visualized the full search trellis for 61 songs, including scale runs, arpeggios, trills, and leap studies, in a single-page dashboard with synced audio playback
Modeled a right-hand-only hardware failure scenario to compare how the optimizer adapts when one hand is unavailable
